description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5915017279984 CAPACITOR-RESISTOR: Line 0001 Qty 30 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0087 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
